tests: Integer-cent money parsing and calendar boundaries are exact
Seed data remains unchanged and generates actual totals, not reference-image invented debt
Pending, cancelled, deleted and future confirmed rows never alter actual aggregates
Transaction validation rejects unsafe money, invalid account, card income and invalid future paid dates
New card closing cycles are stored once and survive card configuration edits
Partial card payments reduce cash and debt once, not expenses; overpayments cannot be saved
Cards isolate invoice payments and available limits and reject insufficient payment cash
Goal contributions reserve cash without adding spending; image and target changes retain progress
Recurring series are pending, bounded to twelve months and deduplicated
Recurrence edit/pause/resume updates only future pending occurrences, preserving confirmed and user-deleted history
Installment generation stops at total and monthly short dates retain original day anchors
Budget total and category limits are independent; repeat is bounded to twelve months
Atomic commit restores all data on storage or validation failure and saves exactly once
